purpose: What this repository states about the change under issue #13, in the shape Quoin's FR-063 record requires. Quoin owns the record schema, its digest, and its retention; this file is the author's statement that gets sealed into one.
not_an_envelope: Quoin's packaged change-assurance-record-v1, proof-attestation-v1, and verification-receipt-v1 schemas are the shapes. This file projects into the record body Quoin requires and derives nothing beyond the digests its own derived_fields names. It is not a local evidence envelope, it retains nothing, and it computes no verdict.
derived_fields: subject.base_revision and impact_snapshot.revision come from the candidate revision the caller names.
source_connections[].revision is that same candidate revision; source_connections[].digest is read from the bytes at the declared path in `sources`.
proof_obligations[].configuration_digest is read from the bytes at that proof's declared `configuration` path.
impact_snapshot.digest is read from the bytes of the Quire static export.
record.digest is computed and written by quoin at seal time; this file never states it.

Nothing else is filled in, defaulted, or discovered. A field this file does not state is a validation failure at seal time, which is the behaviour that makes the record a statement rather than a guess.

requirements.statement: The adopted component versions are classified by the packaged Engineering Assurance compatibility matrix, not by a local restatement of it, and no install line in this repository names a version the matrix calls incompatible.
Generation-conformance and upstream-identity results are produced by this repository's own tools in declared structured formats and transcribed by Quoin without Quoin executing the producer.
Static specification, obligation, and coverage facts come from a Quire export, and Quire does not execute a producer.

Pass, fail, unavailable, inconclusive, not-computed, malformed, partial, stale, suspect, vacuous and tampered remain eleven distinguishable states across the intake path, each demonstrated by a case that produced it, and the generator's own Interface-001 terminal states survive alongside them rather than being collapsed into the attestation's four. The shared vocabulary is twelve. Measured before deletion, per state and per source: the chain alone demonstrated ten and the compatibility census over retained evidence supplied unsupported and malformed. malformed is a declared member of the adapter's producer vocabulary and is now demonstrated by the attested-malformed scenario, derived from the real corpus run, so deleting the census does not weaken this gate to ten. unsupported is not in that vocabulary and was a property of the compatibility mapping alone; its claim is withdrawn with the evidence rather than restated over a refusal or borrowed from the Interface-001 terminal state of the same name, and TC-012 asserts it stays absent.

No repository-local generic runner, evidence envelope, manifest, identity framework, retention store, audit store, anchor file, failure-propagation policer, or aggregate verdict remains in the execution path.

preservation_constraints.statement: The deterministic Boolean oracle, tri-state harness, and shaped proptest strategy slices keep their byte-identical regeneration, their dual-licence SPDX identity, their requirement/clause traceability, their bounded source rendering and 1,048,576-byte per-clause limit, their source-region maps, and their derivation manifests. Every generated artifact still records the digest of its own bytes.

Every declared GenerationErrorCode, HarnessErrorCode and StrategyErrorCode keeps the Interface-001 terminal state it declares, and a rejection still arrives with no partial artifact bundle. Generated, unsupported, invalid-input, backend-unavailable, io-failed and inconclusive stay six distinct terminal states; unsupported and invalid-input in particular are not permitted to collapse into one another.

The exact IR and runtime revisions this crate lowers against agree across the crate's own constants, the dependency declarations, and the lockfile, and every generated manifest continues to record them.

The published crate gains no runtime dependency on Quire or Quoin. The generation producer is an example target, not a library dependency, and the crate's dependency graph is unchanged by this migration.

Every TM-001 row for FR-001 through FR-005, NFR-001, NFR-002 and StR-001 stays 🚧 Planned. Promoting a row is a human-reviewed matrix change and this migration does not make one. The rows this change adds for FR-006 are the only rows it claims.
Hosted CI remains workflow_dispatch only and is not dispatched by this change.

proof_obligations.statement: Every case in the bounded generation corpus reached its declared Interface-001 terminal state at this candidate revision, each discharging at least its declared check floor: the oracle, harness and strategy slices regenerate byte-identically with their SPDX identity and self-consistent artifact digests, and each rejection case produces the diagnostic code and terminal state it declares with no partial bundle.
The IR and runtime revisions this crate lowers against are the same revision in the crate's own constants, the dependency declarations, and the resolved lockfile.
The authoritative static specification, obligation, and coverage facts for this revision are the Quire export, which executes no producer.
The declared MSRV compiles every target of this crate at this candidate revision, against the locked dependency graph, and reports it in cargo's own JSON message stream.

unknowns.statement: engineering-assurance v0.2.0 records accepted.state = pending_human_acceptance and ships no human_acceptance_recorded predicate; the acceptance exists only on main. This repository reports the state the release records and does not gate on it. Filed as agent-ix/engineering-assurance#20.

No ix-flow decision event exists for this change. Only the repository owner may create one, and none was synthesized, so the receipt is expected to read incomplete with a missing decision rather than complete.

FR-003 (Kani obligation lowering) and FR-004 (vacuity and rejection evidence) are specified and have no implementation at this candidate revision: there is no Kani or vacuity code under src/, and every TM-001 row is 🚧 Planned. The generation producer reports on the oracle, harness and strategy slices that exist. This migration preserves the specification and the planned status and manufactures no producer for behaviour that does not exist, because a proof obligation over absent code would be the most complete false green available.

quire coverage does not fail a Coverage Status column that contradicts its own row. The repository-local checker that used to compensate was a second traceability implementation with a hand-copied matrix, and it went with the rest of the generic machinery. The matrix's own note records the upstream conflict. Tracked as agent-ix/quire-contract-ir#21.

A green `make ci` attests to the tree as committed, not to a tree whose Makefile has been edited. Measured on this repository at this candidate revision with three injected defects (a rustfmt violation, a failing test assertion, and an upstream constant the crate does not declare): the control exits 2 at fmt-check, the first of eleven ci prerequisites, having run only that one; with `.IGNORE:` prepended the same tree exits 0, runs all eleven, and fails seven of them -- fmt-check, spec, lint, msrv, upstream-identity, test and assurance-chain -- each printing its diagnostic and none failing the build. assurance-chain is in that list because the chain did notice: the upstream producer's rows became not-computed, the attestation said so because the bytes said so, and the scenario requiring every producer to have reported success went red for exit 1. Make discarded it. Anything that feeds the chain is protected by digest binding and by results derived from producer bytes; the gates that feed nothing into the chain are neutered, and the structural replacement does not reach them. tests/shared_assurance.rs asserts the committed Makefile declares no such directive, which protects a diff review and not an exit code -- under .IGNORE: that test also runs, also fails, and is also swallowed. Recorded, not closed; no policer target was re-added. Filed as agent-ix/quire-contract-codegen#14.

This change supersedes PRs #9, #10 and #12. PR #12's head was never restacked onto PR #10's head, so the two differ. The divergence was read across every domain path: outside evidence/ it is confined to eight files, of which all but two are machinery this change deletes. The unsafe-audit false green was carried forward and the tautological assertion was rejected; both decisions are recorded in the reconciliation commit with the measurement behind them. The four evidence collections retained only on the unmerged variant remain fetchable on their branches, which are not deleted.
